key_difference: (D) implements clearLocalData() as an unconditional d.set(nullptr) and leaves the QThreadData::currentThreadData() guard in the qcollator caller, so the new public API can still re-create thread-local storage during shutdown (and is documented as unsafe), whereas (B) moves that guard into a new QThreadStorageData::clear() so clearLocalData() is unconditionally shutdown-safe and qcollator can drop its private qthread_p.h dependency.
